mapper.sql: refund_id, payment_id, order_id, buyer_id, seller_id, amount, reason, status, audited_by, audit_remark, audited_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund ( refund_id, payment_id, order_id, buyer_id, seller_id, amount, reason, status, audited_by, audit_remark, audited_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{refundId}, #{paymentId}, #{orderId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{amount}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, #{auditedBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{auditRemark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{auditedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM refund WHERE refund_id = #{refundId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT FROM refund
ORDER BY created_at DESC, refund_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT FROM refund WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (seller_id IS NULL OR seller_id = '') ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE refund SET seller_id = #{sellerId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE refund_id = #{refundId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND (seller_id IS NULL OR seller_id = '')

UPDATE refund SET status = #{status}, audited_by = #{auditedBy}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, audited_at = #{auditedAt}, updated_by = #{auditedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE refund_id = #{refundId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND is_deleted = 0
